narrative.headline: 2018 Honda CR-V: engine and braking-assist complaints lead the pack
narrative.summary: Owners filed 2,055 complaints with NHTSA. The biggest cluster is the engine at 503 reports (24%), followed by the forward-collision/automatic-braking system at 383 (19%) and the fuel system at 360 (18%). Steering and electrical round out the top five. The forward-collision system drew the most injuries (10), and one engine report involved a fire. Watch for sudden stalling, automatic braking that triggers with nothing ahead, and gas mixing into the engine oil.
